notes: Access: direct Chrome navigation, no WAF/bot-block; robots.txt has generic 'User-agent: * / Allow: /' with no Claude-specific disallow. Site is Angular/Spartacus on SAP Commerce (Hybris). Tree source: (1) homepage ng-state JSON -> cx-state.cms.components.entities.FabHamBurgerComponent.component.navigationNode gave the live mega-menu under top node 'Furniture' (branches: Living, Bedroom, Dining, Accents, Home Office, Outdoor Furniture, Interior Design Studio); (2) https://www.fabindia.com/sitemap-category.xml cross-checked against the mega-menu per the mandatory sitemap-union rule -- this surfaced 38 distinct live '/furniture/<slug>' category URLs after discarding 'sale-*'/'new-*' filter-variant duplicates and the 'shop/furniture' and 'shop/sale-furniture' View-All/Sale pages (excluded per scope). Counts and node identity: every slug was queried against the site's own OCC REST API (https://apisap.fabindia.com/occ/v2/fabindiab2c/products/search?query=:relevancy:allCategories:<slug>), reading pagination.totalResults as the exact count and breadcrumbCategories[].name as the authoritative site-side name/parent-chain for each node (same technique proven exact in the prior Home-Decor pass on this company). Sanity check: sum of every branch total (Accents 40 + Bedroom 35 + Dining 53 + Kids Furniture 0 + Living 146 + Home Office 5 + Outdoor Furniture 11) = 290, which exactly equals the root 'Furniture' category's own totalResults (290) -- confirms full, non-overlapping coverage of the department with no missed or double-counted branches. Grouping-vs-leaf calls were made the same way: a parent's totalResults was checked against the sum of its children's totalResults and matched exactly in every case (Accents 40=0+3+2+22+3+10; Bedroom 35=17+8+5+5+0; Dining 53=4+14+22+13; Kids Furniture 0=0+0+0; Living 146=15+9+27+5+10+10+4+1+0+28+37; Living>Tables 37=9+28), so every one of those nodes was recorded as a grouping row, not a leaf. IMPORTANT TRAP CAUGHT (brief 7b#1): the whole 'Kids Furniture' branch (Rockers/Tables/Cribs, all currently 0 products) is reachable ONLY from the category sitemap -- it does not appear anywhere in the live mega-menu (checked both the 'Furniture' branch and the separate top-level 'Kids' apparel branch, neither lists it). Included per the mandatory nav+sitemap union rule; each of its 3 leaf slugs returned HTTP 200 with a correct breadcrumbCategories chain via the OCC API confirming they are real, live (if currently empty) category nodes, not dead/retired or misrouted slugs. Excluded per scope: Mirrors (22, Accents branch -- mirrors are always excluded, Wall Decor's remit) and Organisers (2, Accents branch -- standalone storage goods, excluded per the storage-vs-furniture line). Also excluded: 'Interior Design Studio' (a design-consultation service page, not a product listing) and the generic 'shop/furniture' / 'shop/sale-furniture' View-All and Sale pages. Verified as furniture, not decor, by sampling product titles via the same OCC API: 'dining-accents' slug (breadcrumb name 'Breakfast & Tray Tables') returned e.g. 'Ashva Mango Wood Breakfast Table', 'Noble Sheesham Wood Tray Table' -- genuine small tables, included; 'trunks' returned 'Brown Mango Wood Trunk', 'Brown Sandook Sheesham & Acacia Wood Trunk' -- storage-chest furniture, included; 'shelves-racks' returned freestanding wood shelf/rack/wall-storage units -- furniture shelving, included; 'shoe-racks' returned 'Brown 2Tone Sheesham Wood Shoe Cabinet' -- furniture, included; 'home-office' returned study/laptop/office tables -- furniture, included as a single leaf (no further sub-slugs exist; the only other 'office'/'outdoor' sitemap URLs are '/collection/...' seasonal marketing pages, excluded per scope). Two same-named leaf pairs exist under different parents (a 'Chairs'/'Tables' node under both Dining and Living, and a 'Tables' node under Kids Furniture) -- each has a distinct URL slug and distinct breadcrumb parent chain, so sub_category values were written with a disambiguating room prefix (e.g. 'Dining Chairs' vs 'Living Chairs', 'Dining Tables' vs 'Kids Tables') to keep the flat sheet unambiguous; this is a formatting clarification only, not an invented category. No zero-count leaf was omitted (brief 7b rule): Coat Stands & Hangers, Dressing Tables, Rockers, Kids Tables, Cribs and Room Partitions are all live, verified-0 categories and are emitted as normal leaf rows.
